summary: Phase 5 MPCA tickets (2) fully verified — MPCA-112 backend + frontend, MPCA-120 frontend. MPCA-112 backend (POST /api/grant-claims/{cid}/reject): 3/3 pytest tests pass — reject-from-Approved returns 200 with status=Rejected + rejection_reason persisted (GET verified); reject-from-Draft still returns 409; empty reason returns 400. MPCA-112 frontend: on /grant-claims as MPCA persona, selecting the newly Approved claim (GRC-2025-26-0008) reveals only reject-approved-claim-btn (approve-claim-btn / reject-claim-btn / submit-claim-btn hidden). Clicking it opens window.prompt for reason; confirming flips the status pill to REJECTED while the row stays in the list, and the detail panel shows the Rejection Reason block with the entered text. MPCA-120: on /tournaments/16a2fdd5.../finance (Bhopal Division Inter-District Championship, host DIV-IND, 4 DIST-* rows in matrix) as DIV-IND persona, fc-district-filter renders above the tab strip. fc-district-filter-select has 5 options: default 'All Districts · Consolidated (4)' + 4 District bodies (ALIR/BURH/INDO/KHAN). Picking DIST-BURH-IND filters visible District codes to just BURH (plus host row DIST-ALIR-IND per code path r.role==='Host'). Regression: same URL as MPCA (Sanjeev Dua) → filter HIDDEN; same URL as District Secretary (DIST-INDO-IND) → filter HIDDEN. Phase 1-3 regressions verified by code inspection (MPCA-121/124/125/131 comment blocks still in place, code paths unchanged from iteration 75 which fully verified them).
critical_code_review_comments: grant_claims.py L439-463 · reject_grant_claim now allows Submitted/Under_Review/Approved. Empty-reason guard is present (raises 400). Notification fires to division-secretary of the claim's body with severity=warning — good. Approval-audit trail intact: previous approved_amount_inr is NOT cleared on post-approval reject, so the audit UI can still show 'was approved ₹X, then rejected because …' — good pattern.

GrantClaims.jsx L176 · canPostApprovalReject correctly gated on isMPCA && status==='Approved'. The button is styled distinctively (red 'Reject (Audit)' with hover-fill) to communicate the auditing intent — good UX.

GrantClaims.jsx L280-289 · reject-approved-claim-btn only renders in the {canPostApprovalReject} branch, disjoint from the canReview branch (L271-276). No double-render, no duplicate handlers. rejectClaim() is shared but the backend accepts both status transitions.

TournamentFinanceConsole.jsx L154-168 · MPCA-120 filter logic is minimal and correct — canFilterByDistrict guarded on Division persona AND districtRows.length > 1, so MPCA/District personas and tournaments with 0/1 District row correctly hide the control. filteredRows preserves the Host row so the matrix always shows the tournament host even when scoped to a specific visitor District — this is the right behavior for reimbursement claim consolidation.

TournamentFinanceConsole.jsx L365-385 · Default option 'All Districts · Consolidated (N)' communicates the roll-up semantics; the caption changes to reflect the active scope. Non-visual regression note: districtScope state is not persisted in URL — a Division Secretary who deep-links to a filtered view will land back on 'all'. Not a bug for this ticket but worth considering for future UX polish.
